title: Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts

obligations.text: Penalty for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of a loan contract, if charged, shall be treated as 'penal charges' and shall not be levied in the form of 'penal interest' added to the rate of interest charged on advances.
obligations.quote: Penalty, if charged, for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract by the borrower shall be treated as 'penal charges' and shall not be levied in the form of 'penal interest' that is added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.

obligations.text: REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and shall ensure compliance with these guidelines in both letter and spirit.
obligations.quote: The REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and ensure compliance to these guidelines in both letter and spirit.

obligations.text: REs shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.
obligations.quote: The REs shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.

obligations.text: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by REs to customers in the loan agreement and most important terms & conditions / Key Fact Statement (KFS) as applicable, and displayed on the RE's website under Interest rates and Service Charges.
obligations.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by REs to the customers in the loan agreement and most important terms & conditions / Key Fact Statement (KFS) as applicable, in addition to being displayed on REs website under Interest rates and Service Charges.

obligations.text: Whenever reminders for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan are sent to borrowers, the applicable penal charges shall be communicated.
obligations.quote: Whenever reminders for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan are sent to borrowers, the applicable penal charges shall be communicated.

obligations.text: Any instance of levy of penal charges and the reason therefor shall be communicated to the borrower.
obligations.quote: Further, any instance of levy of penal charges and the reason therefor shall also be communicated.

obligations.text: REs must ensure implementation of the fair lending penal charges instructions in respect of all fresh loans availed or renewed from the effective date (January 1, 2024).
obligations.quote: REs may carry out appropriate revisions in their policy framework and ensure implementation of the instructions in respect of all the fresh loans availed/ renewed from the effective date.

obligations.text: For existing loans, the switchover to the new penal charges regime must be ensured on the next review or renewal date, or six months from the effective date of the circular, whichever is earlier.
obligations.deadline: Next review or renewal date, or six months from the effective date of the circular, whichever is earlier
obligations.quote: In the case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be ensured on next review or renewal date or six months from the effective date of this circular, whichever is earlier.

obligations.text: The instructions shall be updated in the relevant Master Directions / Master Circulars of the applicable Regulated Entities (REs).
obligations.quote: and shall be updated in the relevant Master Directions / Master Circulars of the applicable REs. The list of amendments to the Master Directions / Master Circulars has been provided in the Annex.

obligations.text: Applicable NBFCs shall convey in writing to the borrower, in the vernacular language as understood by the borrower, the amount of loan sanctioned along with the terms and conditions including annualised rate of interest and method of application thereof.
obligations.quote: Applicable NBFCs shall convey in writing to the borrower in the vernacular language as understood by the borrower by means of sanction letter or otherwise, the amount of loan sanctioned along with the terms and conditions including annualised rate of interest

obligations.text: Applicable NBFCs shall keep the borrower's acceptance of the loan terms and conditions on their record.
obligations.quote: and keep the acceptance of these terms and conditions by the borrower on its record.

obligations.text: Applicable NBFCs shall mention the penalties charged for late repayment in bold in the loan agreement.
obligations.quote: applicable NBFCs shall mention the penalties charged for late repayment in bold in the loan agreement.

obligations.text: Applicable NBFCs shall mention the penal interest charged for late repayment in bold in the loan agreement.
obligations.quote: applicable NBFCs shall mention the penal interest charged for late repayment in bold in the loan agreement

obligations.text: Penalty charged for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of the loan contract by the borrower shall be treated as penal charges and shall not be levied in the form of penal interest added to the rate of interest charged on advances.
obligations.quote: Penalty, if charged, for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract by the borrower shall be treated as ‘penal charges’ and shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’

obligations.text: No capitalisation of penal charges is permitted, meaning no further interest shall be computed on such charges.
obligations.quote: There shall be no capitalisation of penal charges i.e., no further interest computed on such charges.

obligations.text: REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and must ensure compliance with these guidelines in both letter and spirit.
obligations.quote: The REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and ensure compliance to these guidelines in both letter and spirit.

obligations.text: REs shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.
obligations.quote: The REs shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.

obligations.text: The quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of the loan contract, without being discriminatory within a particular loan or product category.
obligations.quote: The quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract without being discriminatory within a particular loan / product category.

obligations.text: Penal charges for loans sanctioned to individual borrowers for purposes other than business shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.
obligations.quote: The penal charges in case of loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’, shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.

obligations.text: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by REs to customers in the loan agreement and most important terms and conditions.
obligations.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by REs to the customers in the loan agreement and most important terms & conditions

obligations.text: Whenever reminders for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of a loan are sent to borrowers, the applicable penal charges shall be communicated.
obligations.quote: Whenever reminders for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan are sent to borrowers, the applicable penal charges shall be communicated.

obligations.text: Any instance of levy of penal charges, and the reason for it, shall also be communicated to the borrower.
obligations.quote: any instance of levy of penal charges and the reason therefor shall also be communicated.

obligations.text: Penal charges shall be disclosed in the Key Fact Statement (KFS), as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the RE's website under Interest rates and Service Charges.
obligations.quote: Key Fact Statement (KFS) as applicable, in addition to being displayed on REs website under Interest rates and Service Charges.

ratings.finding: No paragraph shows a Board-approved policy on penal charges or similar charges; FC-14 §7.1 only requires an annual Board review of compliance with the code.
No paragraph requires the applicable penal charges to be communicated when reminders for non-compliance are sent to borrowers.
No paragraph requires borrowers to be told each time a penal charge is levied and the reason for it.

ratings.policy_quote: If an EMI is not paid on its due date, **penal interest** of 2% a month is added to the loan's interest rate on the overdue amount until it is paid.
ratings.finding: FC-14 §3.1 sets a 2% monthly penal interest on overdue EMIs but does not reference the fair lending penal charges instructions or the 1 January 2024 effective date for fresh loans, and it adds penal interest to the loan's interest rate, which the instructions may not permit.
ratings.action: Align FC-14 §3.1 with the fair lending penal charges instructions, confirm the regime applies to all fresh loans from 1 January 2024, and stop adding penal interest to the loan's interest rate.

ratings.finding: No policy paragraph sets out a switchover of existing loans to the new penal charges regime on the next review or renewal date, or within six months of the circular's effective date.

ratings.policy_quote: The CCO decides whether it applies, and assigns an owner and a deadline for any change.
ratings.finding: FP-18 §3.3 requires the CCO to review each new RBI circular and assign owners and deadlines for changes, and FP-18 §5.1 requires policies to be reviewed when a regulation changes, but no paragraph explicitly requires the relevant Master Directions or internal policies to be updated once the circular is applied.
ratings.action: Add a step to FP-18 §3.3 requiring the compliance team to record when the affected Master Direction or internal policy has been updated to reflect each circular.

ratings.policy_quote: Loan application screens are in English and Hindi. Applicants are told within 2 working days whether the loan is sanctioned.
ratings.finding: FC-14 covers English and Hindi screens and a sanction notice within 2 working days, but does not require written communication of the sanctioned amount, full terms, annualised interest rate and method of application in the borrower's vernacular language.
ratings.action: Add a step requiring written communication to each borrower, in the vernacular they understand, of the sanctioned amount, all terms and conditions, the annualised interest rate and how it is applied.
